items.text: API Development: Build and maintain reliable APIs using REST and gRPC to smoothly connect frontend user interfaces with our backend data layers.
Asynchronous Messaging: Implement and maintain event-driven features by integrating backend services with Message Queues (MQ) for reliable background processing.
Data Integration: Write efficient database queries and help manage data models.
Maintain 3-Tier Architecture: Help implement clean separation of concerns between the presentation, application, and database layers.
Testing & Quality: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests in Go to ensure the migrated services are rock-solid and match legacy behavior.
Feature Migration: Work alongside senior team members to read existing Java code, understand the business logic, and rewrite it into clean, idiomatic Go.

Golang Experience: 1–3 years of professional experience writing backend services in Go, or a strong personal portfolio showing a deep understanding of Go fundamentals (slices, pointers, basic concurrency).
API & Messaging Skills: Solid understanding of building APIs and practical exposure to Message Queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS, or ActiveMQ) for decoupling services.
Architectural Awareness: Basic understanding of 3-tier application engineering (how a client, server, and database interact).
Database Basics: Familiarity with relational databases (like PostgreSQL or MySQL) and how to write standard SQL queries and ORM frameworks (e.g., GORM).

Microservices & Data Consistency: Formulated architecture requirements for multi-service transactions; implemented robust rollback and compensating transaction strategies to maintain seamless data consistency.
Eagerness to Learn: A growth mindset—you are excited to take feedback from code reviews, learn best practices, and level up your engineering skills.
Experience or exposure to gRPC and Protocol Buffers (protobuf) in Go.
Familiarity with Docker / Kubernetes and basic containerization concepts.
Exposure to cloud platforms (like AWS or GCP).

description.text:
We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong foundation in Golang to join our engineering team.
You will work closely with senior engineers to build services between database and frontend, working within a classic 3-tier application architecture. A key focus of this role will be API development—utilizing both traditional REST interfaces and modern gRPC protocols—as well as managing asynchronous communication using Message Queues (MQ).
Key Responsibilities
- API Development: Build and maintain reliable APIs using REST and gRPC to smoothly connect frontend user interfaces with our backend data layers.
- Asynchronous Messaging: Implement and maintain event-driven features by integrating backend services with Message Queues (MQ) for reliable background processing.
- Data Integration: Write efficient database queries and help manage data models.
- Maintain 3-Tier Architecture: Help implement clean separation of concerns between the presentation, application, and database layers.
- Testing & Quality: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests in Go to ensure the migrated services are rock-solid and match legacy behavior.
- Feature Migration: Work alongside senior team members to read existing Java code, understand the business logic, and rewrite it into clean, idiomatic Go.
Required Skills & Qualifications
- Golang Experience: 1–3 years of professional experience writing backend services in Go, or a strong personal portfolio showing a deep understanding of Go fundamentals (slices, pointers, basic concurrency).
- API & Messaging Skills: Solid understanding of building APIs and practical exposure to Message Queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS, or ActiveMQ) for decoupling services.
- Architectural Awareness: Basic understanding of 3-tier application engineering (how a client, server, and database interact).
- Database Basics: Familiarity with relational databases (like PostgreSQL or MySQL) and how to write standard SQL queries and ORM frameworks (e.g., GORM).
- Microservices & Data Consistency: Formulated architecture requirements for multi-service transactions; implemented robust rollback and compensating transaction strategies to maintain seamless data consistency.
- Eagerness to Learn: A growth mindset—you are excited to take feedback from code reviews, learn best practices, and level up your engineering skills.
Nice to Have
- Experience or exposure to gRPC and Protocol Buffers (protobuf) in Go.
- Familiarity with Docker / Kubernetes and basic containerization concepts.
- Exposure to cloud platforms (like AWS or GCP).
- Experience using Git.
